Opponent characters are never recorded (only readable from our own preset screens).

briefing.text:
Hey officers! **Expedition plan for this week** 👇

📅 **BRACKET**
- **R1 (Fri):** UkraineArchers (299M)
- **R2 (Sat):** Happiness (338M), rematch, they beat us 2–1 last time
- **R3 (Sun):** Holymoly (177M)
- **Goal: 1st place.** R2 is win-only, so no testing that round.

⚔️ **R1 LINEUP** (please set exactly as listed)

**Left (anchor: Hago26)**
- Isterbuk
- Bubobubo
- TheDragonix725
- MuffinKnight
- Tw3aKZ
- Buchacha
- KevinShock

**Middle (anchor: Tuup)**
- LeKo
- Hansi218
- SilverScope
- Terminus323
- TylerG
- Itsgeorgees
- KatieCarmine

**Right (anchor: MHARU)**
- 皇黎
- daybee
- Zeuzo
- Shoex
- Venom17
- Michelo
- DrShabz

**Bench**
- MsPoppycorn, Ilportoghese, Yullong, thesithlor, Heynow, Gaga94, Bungy, JJJRRRBBB, Archerojj + other subs

🧠 **WHY THESE PICKS**
- **Gear set has been our best predictor of Expedition damage for 7 straight fights.** Chaotic Dragoon players have done 41–219K damage/sec, and most Oracle players 4–45K/sec, regardless of power.
- We start **every Chaotic Dragoon player first**, then fill with the Oracle players who have the **highest artifact ATK bonus**.
- **Power alone doesn't decide who plays.** Gear and rune stats reset in Expedition, so a high power number can overstate a player.
- Players on **Mythic or mostly Mythic gear** stay on the bench for now.
- **Benched doesn't mean bad!** It's about matching gear to this mode. Anyone who upgrades to Chaotic Dragoon or fills an empty preset slot moves up the list.

🎯 **STRATEGY**
- Our anchors **Tuup and Hago26** out-anchor every UkraineArchers lane except their leader swagginpanda.
- **MHARU's lane has the smallest edge**, so our strongest carries are stacked there to back him up.

🧪 **WHAT WE'RE TESTING IN R1**
1. **KatieCarmine switched Oracle → Dragoon.** Same player, same artifacts, so this is a clean before/after.
2. **Bench Dragoon players** (DrShabz, Tw3aKZ, Buchacha, KevinShock) vs a real opponent. They beat our low Oracle starters last week.
3. **Carries stacked under our weakest anchor.** Does MHARU's lane hold?
4. **MHARU switched from Loki to Helix.**
5. **Artifact ATK bonus vs damage.** Lanes are evenly mixed this time, so we get a fair comparison.

🚫 **PLEASE NO SWAPS**
- This lineup is a test. Last-minute swaps have happened twice before and they break the data.
- If something looks wrong, **ping me first** instead of changing it.

📸 **AFTER EACH ROUND**
- Screenshots of **all three Details screens** (ours and theirs) help a ton.

Thanks, everyone! 🏹

briefing.text:
Hey officers! **R2 plan vs Happiness** 👇

We won R1 2–1 vs UkraineArchers. Happiness also won R1, so **today decides 1st place.** This round is win-only, no tests.

DPS = avg damage per second over each player's last 5 matches.

⚔️ **R2 LINEUP** (please set exactly as listed)

**Left (anchor: Tuup, +463% lane HP)** · ~809K combined DPS
*Purpose: must-win lane. All Dragoon, built to beat Happiness's Bremsstrahlung or MarkizDeSade lane. KiLess shouldn't land here.*

**Right (anchor: Hago26, +450% lane HP)** · ~811K combined DPS
*Purpose: second must-win lane. All Dragoon, matched to Left on damage and led by our #1 damage dealer. Wins outright if KiLess lands Middle.*
- Hago26 · Dragoon · 288K DPS

**Subs**
*Every Chaotic Dragoon player is deployed. Subs are Oracle players with lower DPS averages, or players on Mythic gear.*
- Yullong · Oracle · 16K DPS
- Terminus323 · Oracle · 15K DPS
- LeKo · Oracle · 10K DPS
- thesithlor · Oracle · 10K DPS
- JJJRRRBBB · Oracle · 8K DPS

- Others (DrFuko, GoatGeass, slenderu, Abr0, Bazal, Prodegie, Banditten, Legitkit, Profetafume, taz96) · Oracle or Mythic gear · no data yet

🔍 **ABOUT HAPPINESS**
*341M power · 48/48 · beat us 2–1 on Nov 7 · beat Holymoly 3–0 in R1 without losing a single player*
- **Their anchors are stronger than ours:**
  - **KiLess** · +767% lane HP · 248K DPS · mixed Dragoon/Griffin/Oracle, all max level. Nobody we have can out-anchor him.
  - **Bremsstrahlung** (leader) · +463% · Oracle · ties Tuup
  - **SamuelV** · +416% · Dragoon · only Tuup and Hago26 beat him
  - **caiman** · +378% · Dragoon mix
  - **XavierGame** · +356% · Oracle
- **Their gear is Oracle-heavy:** 13 Oracle, 10 Dragoon among the 23 who played R1. That's our edge: Dragoon has out-damaged Oracle in every fight we've tracked.
- **Their R1 lanes looked like this:**
  - **KiLess lane:** KiLess plus 4 Oracle and 2 Dragoon, **only 7 players**
  - **Bremsstrahlung lane:** their real fighting lane. Brems + SamuelV + 5 Dragoon damage dealers (Vince13720 hit 162K DPS)
  - **MarkizDeSade lane:** their softest lane. 7 Oracle + 1 Dragoon, weakest anchor (+342%)
- **They move lanes every round.** KiLess has gone Right → Middle → Left → Left across their last 4 rounds, and their dump lane changes too. That's why we're guessing rather than countering directly.
- **Their bench is thin.** Below their top 23, it's mostly low-power Oracle, so expect a lineup close to R1's.

🎯 **STRATEGY**
- Happiness's KiLess is the strongest player we've seen outside Whispers. **Whatever lane he lands on, we probably lose**, so we're built to win the other two.
- Happiness has moved KiLess to a new lane every round we've seen. He was Left in R1, so **we're expecting him Middle or Right.**
- **Left and Right are full Dragoon lanes** with our top damage dealers, built to beat Happiness's other two lanes.
- **Middle is our Oracle lane.** If KiLess lands there, our Dragoon lanes get the matchups we want.
- **MHARU moves from anchor to damage dealer** to make the Left lane hit harder.

📊 **NEW: HOW PICKS ARE MADE**
- We now track every player's **damage per second each round**, and picks use a **running average of each player's last 5 matches**.
- Gear set, character/resonance, runes, and artifacts still factor in, but recent results in Expedition count most. **Your spot is earned in Expedition itself**, so a strong round moves you up next time.

🛠️ **QUICK UPGRADES BEFORE LOCK**
- A few deployed players have empty preset slots. Filling them is the cheapest boost we can get:
  - **Itsgeorgees:** 2nd resonance + mystling
  - **TylerG:** Etched rune + mystling stars
  - **KevinShock:** 2nd resonance + Etched rune
  - **Buchacha:** 2nd resonance, mystling + Etched rune
  - **Tw3aKZ:** both resonance slots
  - **Bubobubo:** 2nd resonance + mystling

🚫 **PLEASE NO SWAPS**
- If something looks wrong, **ping me first** instead of changing it.

📸 **AFTER THE ROUND**
- Screenshots of **all three Details screens** (ours and theirs) please. They feed the DPS averages.

Let's take 1st! 🏹

briefing.text:
🏁 **R3 vs Holymoly: any win clinches 1st place!** Holymoly is 0–6 in flags this week, so we're using this round to test while still winning.
DPS = damage ÷ seconds survived (5-match average). Long fights seem to show lower DPS (likely fewer targets left for splash damage late in the fight), so compare players within the same lane.

**Left (anchor: Hago26, +450% lane HP) · ~1.0M combined DPS**
*Secures a flag vs Holymoly's only real lane. All Dragoon, top damage dealers.*
- Hago26 · Dragoon · 284K DPS
- Michelo · Dragoon · 175K DPS
- MHARU · Dragoon · 160K DPS
- daybee · Dragoon · 118K DPS
- Venom17 · Dragoon · 83K DPS
- KatieCarmine · Dragoon · 65K DPS
- Itsgeorgees · Dragoon · 63K DPS
- TheDragonix725 · Dragoon · 58K DPS

**Middle (anchor: LeKo, +290% lane HP) · ~148K+ combined DPS (4 players have no data yet)**
*Data lane vs Holymoly's weakest lane (~0.2M damage in 5s). Mostly Oracle, with two Dragoon players as in-lane comparisons.*
- Shoex · Oracle · 87K DPS
- Hansi218 · Dragoon · 45K DPS
- Terminus323 · Dragoon · first Dragoon round (Oracle avg 15K)
- LeKo · Oracle · 10K DPS
- Heynow · Oracle · 6K DPS (old bare preset, now filled)
- GoatGeass · Oracle · no data yet
- slenderu · Oracle · no data yet
- Abr0 · Oracle · no data yet

**Right (anchor: Tuup, +463% lane HP) · ~586K combined DPS**
*Artifact test lane, all Dragoon. Players with matching DPS but very different artifact ATK, all in the same fight.*
- Tuup · Dragoon · 95K DPS
- Zeuzo · Dragoon · 96K DPS
- DrShabz · Dragoon · 97K DPS
- Buchacha · Dragoon · 67K DPS
- Bubobubo · Dragoon · 66K DPS
- KevinShock · Dragoon · 57K DPS
- Tw3aKZ · Dragoon · 54K DPS
- TylerG · Dragoon · 54K DPS

🪑 **Subs** *(sitting out so we get data on new players; no reflection on anyone)*
- Ilportoghese · Oracle · 29K DPS
- 皇黎 · Oracle · 25K DPS
- Isterbuk · Oracle · 18K DPS
- SilverScope · Oracle · 18K DPS
- MsPoppycorn · Oracle · 17K DPS
- MuffinKnight · Oracle · 16K DPS
- Yullong · Oracle · 16K DPS
- thesithlor · Oracle · 10K DPS
- DrFuko · Oracle · no data yet
- Gaga94, Bungy, Profetafume, taz96 · Mythic or mixed gear · not deployed
- JJJRRRBBB, Archerojj, Banditten, Prodegie · bare presets · no data yet

🧪 **What we're testing this round**
**1. Do artifacts add damage? (Right lane)**
- *Question:* does higher artifact ATK mean more damage when everything else is equal?
- *Setup:* groups with matching DPS averages but big ATK gaps, all in one fight: **Tuup / Zeuzo / DrShabz** (~96K avg; 6.43% / 4.23% / 2.48% ATK), **Bubobubo vs Buchacha** (3.98% vs 2.73%), **Tw3aKZ / TylerG / KevinShock** (3.53% / 3.30% / 2.18%).
- *If artifacts matter:* the higher-ATK player in each group pulls ahead. *If not:* the order comes out random.
- One round won't settle it. It adds a clean sample to the pile.

**2. First numbers on untested players (Middle)**
- GoatGeass, slenderu and Abr0 have never been deployed. Gives us 5-match averages to start from, so future lane picks aren't guesses.
- **Heynow's first round with a filled preset.** His old rounds (7K and 4K) were on a bare preset. Same Oracle gear, so this shows whether finishing a preset raises damage. Noisy: those rounds were weeks ago vs different opponents.

**3. Is Shoex's Oracle damage repeatable? (Middle)**
- Shoex is our one Oracle player near Dragoon numbers (87K avg vs 10–29K for other Oracle players).
- Same fight as 5 other Oracle players and two Dragoon players. If he leads again, it's him, not his past matchups.

**4. Dragoon vs Oracle in the same fight (Middle)**
- **Hansi218 and Terminus323 (Dragoon)** share the lane with 6 Oracle players, so the gear comparison has no opponent or fight-length difference.

**5. Is it Helix, or Helix + Dragoon? (Middle vs Left)**
- Helix players on Dragoon have topped our damage 6 rounds running.
- GoatGeass, slenderu and LeKo run Helix on **Oracle**. If they stay low while Left's Helix players stay high, the effect comes from the combo, not Helix alone.

**6. Does fight length change DPS? (Left)**
- KatieCarmine did 92K in a 16s fight and 38K in a 17s healing-heavy fight. Left should be a short fight, so her number tells us whether fight length or the opponent caused the drop.

**7. Does Holymoly repeat a third time?**
- Same 24, same lanes, two rounds in a row. If they repeat again, "predictable opponent" becomes a planning rule.

**8. Terminus323's switch to Dragoon (Middle)**
- *Question:* does switching gear sets change a player's damage, with the same character and the same artifacts?
- *Setup:* Terminus323 just moved to Chaotic Dragoon. He averaged **11–18K on Oracle across 5 rounds**, same character (Phynx), same artifacts.
- KatieCarmine went from 3–26K on Oracle to 92K in her first Dragoon round. A second jump like that turns one case into a pattern.
- He now shares the lane with Hansi218 (Dragoon) and Oracle players he used to match, so we get his old numbers vs new *and* a same-fight comparison.

🔍 **About Holymoly**
- 177M power, 0 pts / 0 flags this week (lost 0–3 to Happiness and to UkraineArchers).
- **Same 24 players in the same lanes both rounds.** We expect it again.
- Anchors: Bigjerjer **+313%** (Right, Oracle), Summerinwhy **+248%** (Left, Dragoon on Mythic gear), Călin **+211%** (Middle). All three of ours out-anchor all three of theirs.
- Gear: 4 Chaotic Dragoon (Lokudon, Bigslingus, Godfathagianotti, SeOz) plus ~6 Dragoon on Mythic gear; the rest Oracle, mostly Mythic.
- **Left** is their only real lane. **Right** is Lokudon (179K) plus weak Oracle players. **Middle** did ~0.2M in 5s vs UkraineArchers.
- Thin bench: only 4 unused members.

🎯 **Strategy**
- **Left** locks a flag with our top damage dealers.
- **Right** wins on Dragoon depth and Tuup's lane HP while running the artifact test.
- **Middle** should beat their weakest lane comfortably while collecting new data.
- Even if Middle slips, Left + Right win the match and 1st place.

🧮 **How picks are made**
- Gear set first (Dragoon over Oracle), then 5-match average DPS. Right-lane players are grouped by matching DPS with different artifact ATK. Middle is filled by test value. No Mythic-gear players.

🙏 **Please no swaps.** The groupings are the test. One swap breaks the comparison.

📸 **After the round:** send all three Details screens for both sides, plus Happiness vs UkraineArchers.

keyNotes: Holymoly fielded the same 24 in the same lanes for the third round in a row. We won all three lanes with all 24 alive (5.20M / 3.75M / 5.74M vs 1.90M / 0.67M / 2.87M).
Terminus323's first Dragoon round: 118K/s, top of Middle, up from 11-18K/s on Oracle over 5 rounds. Second same-player switch after KatieCarmine, same result.
Artifact test on Right (same 9s fight): higher ATK bonus did not come out ahead in 2 of 3 groups (Tuup 66K/s at 6.43% vs Zeuzo 117K/s at 4.23%). Heynow on a filled preset: 6K/s, no visible jump.

lessons: **Goal met:** 1st place, 3-0, 7 of 9 flags. Best week so far (Nov 2: 1-2, 3rd; Nov 9: 2-1, 2nd).

**Reading lanes is our biggest edge.** Holymoly repeated the same 24 all three rounds, Happiness kept their R2 lanes in R3, and our R2 concession landed exactly on KiLess. Moonfall did the same thing last week. Check each opponent's last lineup before every round.

**Both lanes we lost were Middle vs a single carry** (swagginpanda 5.43M in R1, KiLess 4.29M in R2). Against a guild with one 300K+/s player, conceding that lane on purpose (R2) beat fighting it (R1).

**Dragoon is the upgrade that pays.** Two players switched gear while keeping the same character and artifacts: KatieCarmine 3-26K to 92K/s, Terminus323 11-18K to 118K/s. Moving our remaining Oracle players to Dragoon is the highest-value change we can make.
**Artifacts still don't predict lane damage.** R3's same-fight test matches the Nov 9 tier tests. Don't build lanes around artifact stars.

**Healing sets fight length.** UkraineArchers' Griffin healers and our own ~3M on R2 Right stretched fights to 13-18s. Survival wins long lanes; compare players' DPS within the same lane, not across lanes.
**Hago26 carried every round** (top DPS in his lane all 3 rounds, 214K/s for the week). Pairing him with an all-Dragoon stack gave us the lane every time.

findings.title: Gear set is the strongest predictor of Expedition DPS
findings.evidence: 10+ fights across our guild and 6 opponents: Dragoon median DPS ~4-6x Oracle. Cleanest test: KatieCarmine, same character and artifacts, Oracle 3-26K/s → Dragoon 92K/s (Nov 20).

findings.title: Sub Dragoon players beat low Oracle starters
findings.evidence: Nov 14: 4 sub Dragoon players (63-100K/s) out-damaged the 4 benched Oracle starters with 2-3M less power each. Prefer a Dragoon sub with a mostly filled preset over a low-DPS Oracle starter.

findings.title: Artifact tiers don't raise lane DPS
findings.evidence: Two tier tests (Nov 12, 13) showed no tier effect within either gear set. Artifacts correlate with individual DPS mostly through high-artifact anchors (account strength).

findings.title: Anchor Lane HP alone doesn't decide a lane
findings.evidence: Counter-examples: Moonfall's Pyronic (Nov 9 week) and our Tuup vs swagginpanda (Nov 20). A 300K/s Dragoon carry plus a Dragoon lane can beat a higher anchor.

findings.title: Helix + Dragoon leads our DPS
findings.evidence: 6 rounds in a row Helix on Dragoon has the highest median (e.g. ~121K/s vs ~56K/s for other characters on Dragoon, Nov 21). Observe only; no test yet.

findings.title: Healing stretches fights and lowers per-second DPS
findings.evidence: Griffin/heavy-healing lanes (UA Left Nov 20, our Right Nov 21) push everyone's DPS down. Compare DPS within a lane.

findings.title: Early deaths snowball
findings.evidence: Expedition Talents: +4% damage per additional player alive and per additional deployed member on the lane. All-Dragoon stacks avoid early Oracle deaths.

findings.title: Empty preset slots underperform
findings.evidence: JJJRRRBBB (no resonance, no mystling) 32K, Heynow 63K (Nov 6). Fill presets before deploying.

mechanics.laneHp: Anchor = the deployed player with the most Mythic artifact stars on a lane. Lane HP buff = 18% per Mythic star + 1.8% per Legendary star (anchor's stars only).
mechanics.atk: Each player: +0.25% ATK per Mythic star, +0.025% per Legendary star.
mechanics.sacredGear: Lane member with the most top-quality gear grants DMG reduction to the lane: +1.8% per Chaotic piece, +1.2% per Mythic piece (max 10.8%).
mechanics.talents: +4% DMG per additional deployed member on the lane (full lane +28%); +4% DMG to all per additional player alive (death snowball).
mechanics.stats: Battle HP fixed at 50,000 and ATK at 200 for everyone; power does not enter battle. Guild-tier ATK bonus starts at 36s; fights end well before.
mechanics.lock: Deployments lock Fri 12:00 UTC; the opponent lineup is viewable for 2h after.
mechanics.ties: Points (win 3, draw 1) → flags → total damage of deployed players.
